verses.text: She folds the letter twice before deciding not to send it.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Ash settles on the sill where she rests her cup—

morning finds the words still folded, still hers alone.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A jade moth taps the glass, wanting the lamp—

she lets it in, lets it stay till morning.

By dawn its wings have gone silver with dust—
she opens her palm, lets it choose the window or not.

It lifts once, circles the empty cup—

folds it once more, tucks it beneath the cup.
